label: L-08
title: Ownable used instead of Ownable2Step across all three contracts — ownership transfer is irreversible if the new owner address is incorrect
description: Both contracts use OpenZeppelin Ownable rather than Ownable2Step. A single-step ownership transfer is irreversible if the new owner address is a typo, a contract without the expected interface, or a compromised address.
impact: Low severity operational risk; not an active exploit path. Remediable by migrating to Ownable2Step.
attackPath: Owner calls transferOwnership(typoAddress) with a mistyped address
Single-step transfer is irreversible; no pending-accept mechanism
If typoAddress is not accessible, all onlyOwner functions are permanently locked
